nodes.long_description:
1. Pre-departure safety check: Hold onto the chair handles and do a pre-departure safety check.
2. Safety on curves: Keep a firm grip on the handles on curves, which can cause accidents.
3. Arriving at and exiting a stop: Make sure the bus has come to a complete stop when you arrive at your stop and exit safely.
4. Moving and crossing the street: After getting off, move to the area highlighted in green, and at crossings, check the signal before crossing.
5. Move to the opposite stop: Check the highlighted markings and move to the opposite stop.
6. Wait safely before the bus arrives: Check for hazards and wait safely before the bus arrives.
7. Make sure it's safe to board: Board the bus safely when it arrives.
8. Prepare for emergencies: In an emergency, use the emergency hammer to break a window and evacuate if the door is blocked.
nodes.short_description: Experience the safety protocols in public transportation. This simulation emphasizes the importance of being aware and prepared in different transit scenarios.

nodes.long_description: "Dive into the realm of realistic experiments through Virtual Reality (VR). Experience the excitement of conducting actual reactions in a risk-free digital laboratory. Mix substances, observe genuine changes, and engage with lifelike molecular structures—all in an immersive 3D environment. Enhance your learning by interacting with accurate representations of laboratory equipment and substances, all while honing your scientific skills. Explore the world of chemistry in an unprecedented way, where hands-on experimentation meets cutting-edge technology for an educational adventure like no other.
nodes.short_description: Explore the world of chemistry in an unprecedented way, where hands-on experimentation meets cutting-edge technology for an educational adventure like no other. This package includes collection of 1 experiment.  This application supports two languages, Korean and English.
